cues.en: Hello my friends, and welcome to this new hands-on tutorial on building containers with Amazon ECR, Elastic Container Registry.
cues.zh: 朋友們好，歡迎來到用 Amazon ECR，Elastic Container Registry 建立容器的實作。

cues.en: So before we start, just a quick reminder of how ECR works for machine learning model deployment.
cues.zh: 開始前，快速提醒 ECR 在模型部署的作用。

cues.en: Well basically, here are the steps.
cues.zh: 步驟如下。

cues.en: First, you build the Docker image, you package your model dependencies and inference code in a Docker file.
cues.zh: 先建 Docker 映像，用 Dockerfile 封裝模型相依套件與推論程式。

cues.en: Then you push it to ECR by uploading the image to your private ECR repository using Docker push, and then you deploy from ECR.
cues.zh: 再用 docker push 上傳私有 ECR 儲存庫，接著從 ECR 部署。

cues.en: So for example, since we already covered SageMaker, well with SageMaker, it will pull the image to create a custom inference endpoint as we saw before with SageMaker.
cues.zh: 例如 SageMaker，會拉取映像，建立自訂推論端點。

cues.en: Okay?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: So basically the most important thing that you have to remember for the exam is that ECR will store and manage your machine learning model containers, so that then they can be deployed consistently
cues.zh: 考試最重要是記住，ECR 儲存、管理模型容器，讓它們能一致地部署到

cues.en: across other AWS services.
cues.zh: 其他 AWS 服務。

cues.en: All right, so here we go.
cues.zh: 開始。

cues.en: Let's go to the search bar and let's enter ECR.
cues.zh: 搜尋 ECR。

cues.en: You don't have to write the whole Elastic Container Registry.
cues.zh: 不必輸入完整名稱。

cues.en: Here it is, fully managed Docker Container Registry where you can share and deploy indeed your machine learning models in the form of containers.
cues.zh: 就在這裡，全受管 Docker 容器登錄庫，可分享、部署容器形式的模型。

cues.en: All right, so here we go.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: Let's enter the service Elastic Container Registry, and I'll just show you how to create a repository.
cues.zh: 進 ECR，展示建立儲存庫。

cues.en: We won't do the full deployment of course, because this would require us to rebuild and redeploy our machine learning models, for example, on SageMaker.
cues.zh: 不做完整部署，否則要重建、重新部署模型，例如到 SageMaker。

cues.en: But I'll just show you the steps and this will be way enough for you to smash any ECR related question at the exam.
cues.zh: 只展示步驟，足夠回答 ECR 考題。

cues.en: Okay?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: So here we go.
cues.zh: 開始。

cues.en: Let's click Create.
cues.zh: 按 Create。

cues.en: First we have to give a name to our repository so we can first just call namespace machinelearning and then call the repository, for example, deployment.
cues.zh: 先命名，可用命名空間 machinelearning，儲存庫例如 deployment。

cues.en: Okay?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: Then we have to configure the image tag settings, and here we can choose between a mutable image tag or an immutable image tag.
cues.zh: 設定映像標籤，可選 Mutable 或 Immutable。

cues.en: So basically the difference is that mutable image tags can be overridden while immutable image tags can't be overridden.
cues.zh: Mutable 可覆寫，Immutable 不可覆寫。

cues.en: Okay?
cues.zh: 明白嗎？

cues.en: Low chance that this will come up at the exam, but still it's always good to know.
cues.zh: 考試機率低，但知道很好。

cues.en: Okay, so let's keep mutable, that's fine.
cues.zh: 保留 Mutable。

cues.en: Then we have the encryption settings, which can't be changed, by the way, once the repository is created.
cues.zh: 加密設定，建立後不能變。

cues.en: And here we have the choice between the AES-256 encryption or the AWS-KMS encryption, which would require you
cues.zh: 可選 AES-256，或 AWS KMS，後者需要

cues.en: to either use an AWS managed key or a customer managed key.
cues.zh: AWS 受管或客戶受管金鑰。

cues.en: And if you choose this, you can actually create a new AWS-KMS key in the AWS-KMS service.
cues.zh: 若選它，可到 AWS KMS 建新金鑰。

cues.en: Okay?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: But let's use actually the AES-256 encryption, which is the industry standard advanced encryption standard encryption.
cues.zh: 這裡用 AES-256，業界標準的進階加密標準。

cues.en: And there you go, that's it.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: Here we have some image scanning settings that are deprecated, so no need to do anything here.
cues.zh: 有些映像掃描設定已棄用，不必處理。

cues.en: And we can finally click Create and this will create your repository.
cues.zh: 最後按 Create，建立儲存庫。

cues.en: And there you go.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: You successfully created your machine learning deployment repository, after which you can now upload your Docker image that packages your model dependencies
cues.zh: 成功建立模型部署儲存庫，接著可上傳封裝模型相依套件

cues.en: and inference code into your private ECR repository using Docker push, after which you can then deploy from ECR.
cues.zh: 與推論程式的 Docker 映像，用 docker push 到私有 ECR，再部署。

cues.en: Okay?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: And now let's imagine that we already uploaded the Docker image in our private repository machinelearning/deployment.
cues.zh: 假設已將映像上傳到 machinelearning/deployment。

cues.en: How do we find it?
cues.zh: 如何找到？

cues.en: Well, it's super simple.
cues.zh: 非常簡單。

cues.en: You click on your ECR private repository, and there you go.
cues.zh: 點私有儲存庫。

cues.en: It will directly take you to the images that you upload in your private repository using Docker push.
cues.zh: 直接看到用 docker push 上傳的映像。

cues.en: And speaking of Docker push, well, this is how you can view your push commands.
cues.zh: 說到 docker push，這裡看推送指令。

cues.en: And here you have all the instructions on how to use Docker push to upload your Docker images containing your machine learning model inference code to your private repository.
cues.zh: 有全部說明，如何將包含模型推論程式的 Docker 映像推送到私有庫。

cues.en: So here, this is for macOS or Linux, and here you have the instructions for Windows.
cues.zh: 這裡 macOS／Linux，這裡 Windows。

cues.en: Okay, so for example, on macOS or Linux, how do you build your Docker image?
cues.zh: 例如 macOS／Linux，如何建映像？

cues.en: Well, you do this by using this following command, which you can just copy and then paste in the AWS CLI.
cues.zh: 使用以下指令，可複製貼到命令列；講者稱 AWS CLI。

cues.en: Okay?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: Then after the build completes, you can tag your image so that you can push the image to your private ECR repository.
cues.zh: 建置完成，替映像加標籤，才能推到私有 ECR。

cues.en: And finally, you run this following command here to push your image to your private ECR repository.
cues.zh: 最後執行這個指令推送。

cues.en: And that's exactly the Docker push I was telling you about.
cues.zh: 就是剛才說的 docker push。

cues.en: All right, so there you go.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: You now know how to create a private ECR repository.
cues.zh: 現在知道如何建私有 ECR。

cues.en: You also know how to Docker push an image containing your machine learning model inference code and all the other dependencies to your private ECR repository.
cues.zh: 也知道如何推送含推論程式與相依套件的映像。

cues.en: And now in the next tutorials, we'll see how to deploy from the other containers, which are ECS, Elastic Container Service, and EKS, Elastic Kubernetes Service.
cues.zh: 接下來看其他容器部署服務，ECS 與 EKS。

cues.en: So I look forward to seeing you in these next hands-on tutorials.
cues.zh: 期待接下來見。

cues.en: And until then, enjoy machine learning with AWS.
cues.zh: 在那之前，享受 AWS 機器學習的樂趣吧。
